notes.title: small update
notes.content: [p]1. Fixed a problem where respawns caused chain reactions.[/p][p]2. Made subtle changes to the stage management. This part may need to be adjusted several times.[/p][p]3. Eliminated collisions with enemy planes that would randomly crash into you from behind.[/p][p]4. Added support for Input U/D-Axis Reverse. Use this with a joystick-type controller.[/p][p]5. Fixed the behavior of enemy missiles. This part may need to be adjusted several times.[/p][p]Other[/p][p]- Achievements have not yet been incorporated.[/p][p]- The next update is scheduled for September, when we will have more time to work on it.[/p]
